correctness.rationale: Classification premise is Franco Muñoz Theorem 6 and Propositions 7-8: exactly E0 and E1 non-thin canonical forms in characteristic 2. Parameter counts q^7-q^6 and q^5-q^4 and local algebra closure checked. Ambient substitutions t->ut+sum c_j t^j generated by scalings and triangular elementary maps; exhaustive orbit BFS covers F2 (80 subalgebras, 11 orbits, E0 6x8+1x16 and E1 4x4) and F4 (13,056 subalgebras, 29 orbits, E0 14x384+1x768+4x1536 and E1 4x48+6x96). Independently implemented finite-field RREF, polynomial multiplication, and generator action for both q values; reran full q4 enumeration and q2. These finite sets are exhaustive conditional on the cited normal-form classification and generator-completeness argument, not a classification for q>4.
